# Struthers Legal APC

> > Los Angeles law firm specializing in landlord-tenant disputes, real estate code enforcement, and employment law matters throughout California.

Founded by Sasha Alexis Struthers, the firm focuses on REAP hearings, evictions, cash-for-keys negotiations, FEHA compliance, wage and hour disputes, and workplace discrimination cases. Struthers Legal serves property managers, landlords, employers, and employees navigating California's complex legal landscape.

## Key Topics

- FEHA (Fair Employment & Housing Act)
- REAP (Rent Escrow Account Program)
- LADBS (LA Department of Building & Safety)
- LARSO (LA Rent Stabilization Ordinance)
- LAHD (LA Housing Department)
- Landlord-Tenant Law
- Employment Law
- Wage and Hour Claims
- Workplace Discrimination
- Wrongful Termination
- Evictions and Unlawful Detainer
- Cash-for-Keys Negotiations
- Real Estate Code Enforcement
- Whistleblower Protection
- California Labor Law

## Practice Areas

- [Employment Law Services](https://www.struthers.legal/employment): Employment law services: wage/hour, discrimination, wrongful termination
